text:
Lithium and sodium are in Group I of the Periodic Table.
Which statements about the properties of lithium and sodium are correct?
1
Lithium has a lower melting point than sodium.
2
They both produce hydrogen when they react with water.
3
Lithium is less dense than sodium.
4
Lithium is more reactive than sodium.
A
1 and 2
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
3 and 4
subject: Chemistry
